responsibility: Defines rustc’s proc-macro support for diagnostics by exposing the `Diagnostic`, `LintDiagnostic`, and `Subdiagnostic` derive entry points, generating the corresponding diagnostic and subdiagnostic trait implementations from annotated structs and enums, and sharing the builder, parsing, and validation machinery that turns diagnostic attributes into concrete error-construction calls. It also provides the proc-macro error-reporting layer for invalid derive usage and the `fluent_messages` macro that validates Fluent resources and generates the typed message constants those derives use, so the module works as a complete pipeline from Fluent message definitions and annotated Rust types to checked diagnostic code generation.
